label: Transaction-scoped Durability Level (Java SDK)
type: a single DurabilityLevel setting (Majority / MajorityAndPersistToActive / PersistToMajority / None) that applies to every key-value write inside one transaction attempt, configured once via TransactionsConfig/ClusterEnvironment (or per-call for a single query transaction) rather than per individual mutation call
note: Deliberately NOT the same concept as sdk:durability (kv-operations.md's per-operation durability option, itself still extraction-layer only) - same underlying DurabilityLevel enum values, but the two are configured through entirely different, non-interchangeable API surfaces (TransactionsConfig.durabilityLevel(...) / singleQueryTransactionOptions().durabilityLevel(...) vs. InsertOptions.durability(...)). Related via relations/shares-option-set-with.json rather than treated as the same term. The same enum recurs at a THIRD scope again on the single-query-transaction page - see reconciliation.md round 4.
